metadata.question: Did the global ocean surface color show a shift toward a greener hue between 2002 and 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - We need a truly global, long-term ocean-color dataset. - MODIS-Aqua (2002-present) is the best match: global, 4-km, ocean-color bands including Rrs at 555 nm (green) and 443 nm (blue). - Collection: “NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI” (daily 4-km). - Periods: 2002 and 2022, full calendar years (Jan-Dec) to avoid seasonality bias. - Region: a single global geometry (a large polygon covering most ocean) so the reduceRegion call completes quickly at 4 km. 2. Masking strategy: - Ocean-color products are already masked to water pixels (quality flags already applied). - We still apply the supplied “qa” band mask to be safe. 3. Logic / index: - A simple proxy for “greener hue” is the green-to-blue remote-sensing reflectance ratio: GBR = Rrs_555 / Rrs_443 - Compute the spatial mean GBR for 2002 and 2022. - If 2022 GBR > 2002 GBR → shift toward greener → answer A (Yes). - Check for empty collections (C1), zero valid pixels after masking (C2), and None/NaN (C3). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') ocean = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[-180,-60,180,-60,180,60,-180,60,-180,-60]], None, False) def gbr_year(year): col = (ee.ImageCollection("NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI") .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year')) .filterBounds(ocean) .select(['Rrs_555', 'Rrs_443', 'qa']) .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa').gte(1)))) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None img = col.mean() gbr = img.select('Rrs_555').divide(img.select('Rrs_443')) val = gbr.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=ocean, scale=4000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Rrs_555').getInfo() return val g2002 = gbr_year(2002) g2022 = gbr_year(2022) print(f"2002 GBR: {g2002}") print(f"2022 GBR: {g2022}") if g2002 is None or g2022 is None: print("C1") elif g2002 != g2002 or g2022 != g2022: # NaN check print("C3") elif g2022 > g2002: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

ocean = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[-180,-60,180,-60,180,60,-180,60,-180,-60]], None, False)

def gbr_year(year):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection("NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI")
             .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year'))
             .filterBounds(ocean)
             .select(['Rrs_555', 'Rrs_443', 'qa'])
             .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa').gte(1))))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None
    img = col.mean()
    gbr = img.select('Rrs_555').divide(img.select('Rrs_443'))
    val = gbr.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                           geometry=ocean, scale=4000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Rrs_555').getInfo()
    return val

g2002 = gbr_year(2002)
g2022 = gbr_year(2022)
print(f"2002 GBR: {g2002}")
print(f"2022 GBR: {g2022}")

if g2002 is None or g2022 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif g2002 != g2002 or g2022 != g2022:  # NaN check
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif g2022 > g2002:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
